text: Thank you for calling billing support. How can I help you with the account today?
Hello, my monthly statement never arrived and I want to review the delivery settings for the account.
I can help with that. Let me review the notification preferences and the document delivery workflow.
The secure portal shows nothing new, and the archive does not contain the expected document either.
Thanks. I see paperless delivery was disabled, which is why the statement did not arrive. I have re-enabled it.
Great. Please post a recap of the troubleshooting steps and the expected follow-up to the secure portal.
